items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The third one’s name was Saverra, and the fourth one’s name was Farazil.

ctx.x: Yeah. Wait a minute. The third one’s name was Saverra, and the fourth one’s name was Farazil.

Farazil. Now, the girl’s names were a little bit better. My mother’s eldest sister – because she was the second girl – her name was Viva. My mother’s name was Earle. The next daughter’s name was – oh man, it’s – Baymeta.
